prompt: The JDialog blocks the main window even though it should be non-modal. Why?
choices: JDialog is always modal by default
The third constructor parameter is 'true' for modal — change to 'false' for non-modal
explanation: new JDialog(parentFrame, title, modal) — the boolean controls modality. true = modal (blocks the parent). false = modeless (parent remains interactive). Change to: new JDialog(frame, "Info", false);
